rules.rule: Minimum end distance e1 (parallel to load direction)
rules.source_quote: End distance e1 ≥ 1.2d0 (Table 3.3 minimum)

rules.rule: Minimum edge distance e2 (perpendicular to load direction)
rules.source_quote: Edge distance e2 ≥ 1.2d0 (Table 3.3 minimum); NOTE: pre-2005 ENV draft gave 1.5d0 — that value is superseded

rules.rule: Minimum slotted-hole distances e3 and e4 (to slot centre)
rules.source_quote: Table 3.3: e3 (end of slot) ≥ 1.5d0; e4 (edge to slot centre) ≥ 1.5d0

rules.rule: Minimum bolt pitch p1 (in direction of load)
rules.source_quote: Spacing p1 ≥ 2.2d0 (Table 3.3 minimum)

rules.rule: Minimum bolt pitch p2 (perpendicular to load direction)
rules.source_quote: Spacing p2 ≥ 2.4d0 (Table 3.3 minimum)

rules.rule: Maximum edge distance e1, e2 — member exposed to weather or corrosion
rules.units: mm (t = thickness of thinner outer connected part)
rules.source_quote: Table 3.3 maximum: e1, e2 ≤ 4t + 40 mm (exposed to weather / corrosion)

rules.rule: Maximum edge distance e1, e2 — member not exposed to weather
rules.units: mm (t = thickness of thinner outer connected part)
rules.source_quote: Table 3.3 maximum: e1, e2 ≤ max(8t, 125 mm) for non-exposed members

rules.rule: Maximum bolt pitch p1, p2 (standard, tension or shear members)
rules.units: mm (t = thickness of thinner outer connected part)
rules.source_quote: Table 3.3 maximum: p1, p2 ≤ min(14t, 200 mm)

rules.rule: Maximum pitch p1 for inner bolt rows in compression direction
rules.value: smaller of 28t or 400 mm (single free-source; verify against EN 1993-1-8 Table 3.3)
rules.source_quote: Table 3.3 compression-member inner rows: p1,i ≤ min(28t, 400 mm); outer rows: min(14t, 200 mm)

rules.rule: Maximum spacing p1, p2 — unprotected weathering steel (EN 10025-5)
rules.units: mm (t_min = thickness of the thinner outer connected part)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 2.3 (Table 3.3 in EN 1993-1-8): structures made from steels conforming to EN 10025-5, steel used unprotected — spacing p1, p2: The smaller of 14tmin or 175 mm

rules.rule: Bearing-resistance un-reduced threshold — end distance e1
rules.value: e1 ≥ 1.5·d0 (below this, αd bearing factor reduces; see bolt-shear-and-bearing)
rules.source_quote: Table 3.4: for bearing not to be reduced, e1 ≥ 1.5d0 (entering the αd formula)

rules.rule: Bearing-resistance un-reduced threshold — pitch p1
rules.source_quote: Table 3.4: for bearing not to be reduced, p1 ≥ 3.75d0

rules.rule: Standard round-hole clearance — M12 and M14 bolts
rules.value: +1 mm (d0 = 13 mm for M12; 15 mm for M14)
rules.source_quote: M12, M14: clearance = 1 mm (d0 = d + 1 mm); note: commonly mis-stated as +2 mm

rules.rule: Standard round-hole clearance — M16 to M24 bolts
rules.source_quote: M16, M18, M20, M22, M24: clearance = 2 mm (d0 = d + 2 mm)

rules.rule: Standard round-hole clearance — M27 and larger bolts
rules.source_quote: M27 and larger: clearance = 3 mm (d0 = d + 3 mm)

rules.rule: Oversized round hole clearance — bolt diameter M12 and M14
rules.value: +3 mm (d0 = 15 mm for M12; 17 mm for M14)
rules.source_quote: bauforumstahl Arbeitshilfe 5.2 Tabelle 1 (Nennlochspiel), Übergroße runde Löcher: Lochspiel 3 for d = 12 and 14 (d0 = 15, 17)

rules.rule: Oversized round hole clearance — bolt diameter M16 to M22
rules.value: +4 mm (d0 = 20 mm for M16; 26 mm for M22)
rules.source_quote: bauforumstahl Arbeitshilfe 5.2 Tabelle 1 (Nennlochspiel), Übergroße runde Löcher: Lochspiel 4 for d = 16 to 22 (d0 = 20, 22, 24, 26)

rules.rule: Oversized round hole clearance — bolt diameter M24
rules.source_quote: bauforumstahl Arbeitshilfe 5.2 Tabelle 1 (Nennlochspiel), Übergroße runde Löcher: Lochspiel 6 for d = 24 (d0 = 30)

rules.rule: Oversized round hole clearance — bolt diameter M27 and above
rules.value: +8 mm (d0 = 35 mm for M27; 44 mm for M36)
rules.source_quote: bauforumstahl Arbeitshilfe 5.2 Tabelle 1 (Nennlochspiel), Übergroße runde Löcher: Lochspiel 8 for d = 27 to 36 (d0 = 35, 38, 44)

rules.rule: P358 practical hole clearance convention (standardised connections)
rules.value: d + 2 mm for d ≤ 24 mm; d + 3 mm for d > 24 mm; holding-down (HD) bolts d + 6 mm
rules.source_quote: P358: standard holes d + 2 mm (d ≤ 24 mm), d + 3 mm (d > 24 mm); HD bolts d + 6 mm. Note: for M12/M14 use EN +1 mm, not P358's +2 mm

rules.rule: Design preload of a preloaded bolt Fp,C
rules.units: kN (fub = bolt tensile strength N/mm², As = tensile stress area mm²)
rules.source_quote: P358 §6 Check 4: Fp,C = 0.7 fub As; preloaded assemblies are property class 8.8 or 10.9 to BS EN 14399

rules.rule: Bolt protrusion beyond the nut after tightening
rules.citation: BS EN 1090-2 §8.2.2 (SCI AD 426; SBE Multi-Storey Part 7 §10.1.3)
rules.source_quote: SCI AD 426: To ensure that bolt threads are fully engaged in the nut, BS EN 1090-2 clause 8.2.2 specifies that the protrusion must be at least one thread pitch. SBE MS Part 7 §10.1.3: The bolt shall protrude from the face of the nut, after tightening, not less than one full thread pitch.

rules.rule: Threads within the grip length — non-preloaded bolts
rules.value: ≥ 1 full thread within the grip length (between bolt head and nut)
rules.source_quote: SCI AD 426: The same clause specifies the necessary numbers of threads within the grip length (between bolt head and the nut). For non-preloaded bolts, one full thread is required

rules.rule: Threads clear between nut bearing face and unthreaded shank — preloaded HR / HRC bolts
rules.value: ≥ 4 full threads (in addition to the thread run-out)
rules.citation: BS EN 1090-2 §8.2.2 (SCI AD 426; BCSA Model Specification for structural bolting assemblies, Table 2 note 2)
rules.source_quote: BCSA: Bolt lengths shall be selected to ensure that a minimum number of four full threads (in addition to the thread run-out) remain clear between the bearing surface of the nut and the unthreaded part of the shank. SCI AD 426: For preloaded bolts according to BS EN 14399-3 … or according to BS EN 14399-10 …, a minimum of four threads within the tensioned length is specified.

rules.rule: Selecting bolt length from grip (derived from the §8.2.2 protrusion rule)
rules.value: l ≥ grip + Σ washer thickness h (bolt.washer.thickness.*) + nut height m (bolt.nut.height.*) + 1·P (bolt.thread.pitch.*); choose the next standard length l_nom (EN 14399-3 Table 2) and check the threads-in-grip rule (bolt.length.threads.grip.*)
rules.source_quote: SCI AD 426: To ensure that bolt threads are fully engaged in the nut, BS EN 1090-2 clause 8.2.2 specifies that the protrusion must be at least one thread pitch.
